faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Short answers. The help centre has step-by-step guides.

what.a: An account for depositing crypto, investing it in products with published terms and withdrawing it, with every balance kept on a double-entry ledger you can inspect.

guaranteed.a: No. Results can be positive or negative, and only realised results are added to your position. No page shows a projected return.

hold.q: Why can’t I withdraw a new deposit straight away?
hold.a: For 7 days after a deposit is credited it can be invested but not withdrawn. This protects all customers against payment fraud and money laundering. Your dashboard shows when each held amount is released.

term.a: Money invested in a 28-day product stays in that position for 28 days. The progress bar shows elapsed time only. At maturity the position is released to your available balance once the result for its last period is posted.

fees.a: Withdrawals: a 3% platform fee plus the blockchain network fee, both shown before you confirm. Products may charge a performance fee on gains and, where early exit is allowed, an early-exit fee. Deposits are free.

withdrawTime.q: How long does a withdrawal take?
withdrawTime.a: Each request is reviewed by staff before it is sent, and larger amounts need a second approver, so timing depends on that review. You can follow every step on the withdrawals page and you get an email when the funds are sent.

referral.q: How does the referral programme work?
referral.a: You get 5% of each confirmed deposit made by people you invite and 2% of their realised, posted profit. Rewards are paid by the platform, not taken from the person you invited, and they stay pending for a short check before they are credited.

wrongNetwork.q: I sent funds on the wrong network. What now?
wrongNetwork.a: Contact support with the transaction hash. Funds sent on an unsupported network or without a required memo may not be recoverable; when they can be, recovery requires a manual review.

keys.q: Will you ever ask for my seed phrase?
keys.a: Never. We store only public withdrawal addresses. Nobody from Ledgerline will ask for your password, two-factor codes, private keys or seed phrase.

verify.q: Do I need to verify my identity?
verify.a: Identity verification may be required before you can get a deposit address, invest or withdraw, depending on your country and the law that applies to us.

demo.a: A demo deployment shows a banner on every page. Its balances and transactions are test data and have no value.

howItWorks.title: How Ledgerline works
howItWorks.lead: What happens to your money at each step, which rules apply and what you can check yourself.

ledger.title: The ledger
ledger.p1: Every balance you see is calculated from ledger entries. Each operation is recorded as a transaction whose debits and credits are equal, and recorded entries cannot be edited or deleted — a correction is a new, separately approved entry.
ledger.p2: In your transaction history you can open any line and see the entries behind it.

deposits.title: Deposits
deposits.p1: You get a personal address for each network. Send only the asset and network shown on the deposit page; some networks also need a memo or tag. A deposit is credited after the required number of blockchain confirmations.
deposits.p2: Deposits that fail an automated risk check are held for review by our compliance staff before anything is credited.

hold.title: The 7-day rule
hold.p1: A credited deposit cannot be withdrawn for 7 days. During that time you can invest it. Your dashboard shows the held amount separately and the date it is released.

investing.title: Investing and the 28-day term
investing.p1: Each product describes what generates its return, its term, fees, limits and risks. When you invest, the amount moves from available to invested and the product terms you accepted are stored with your position.
investing.p2: The term progress bar shows elapsed time only. It is not a projection of profit.

results.title: How results are posted
results.p1: After a period ends, our finance team records the realised result with evidence, such as an exchange or custodian statement. A second staff member must approve it before it is posted. Results are allocated to every position that was open during the period in proportion to the time it was open.
results.p2: A performance fee is charged only on gains. Losses are posted in exactly the same way as gains. If a term ends before the result for its last period is posted, the position shows "awaiting settlement" until it is.

withdrawals.title: Withdrawals and fees
withdrawals.p1: Withdrawals go only to addresses you have added and confirmed by email; a new address can be used after a short cooldown. Before you confirm, you see a quote with the platform fee (3%), the network fee and the exact amount that will arrive.
withdrawals.p2: Every request is reviewed by staff before it is sent. Requests above a set amount need approval from two different people, and the person who sends the funds cannot be the one who confirms the payment arrived.

example.label: Worked example
example.note: The network fee differs by network and is shown in your quote.

referrals.title: Referral programme
referrals.p1: When someone you invite makes a confirmed deposit, you receive 5% of that deposit. When they earn a realised, posted profit, you receive 2% of that profit. Both rewards are paid by the platform from its own revenue; nothing is deducted from the person you invited.
referrals.p2: Rewards stay pending for a short period and are checked for abuse, such as self-referral, before they are credited.

security.title: Security
security.p1: Sign-in sessions use secure cookies that scripts cannot read. Two-factor authentication is required to add withdrawal addresses and to withdraw. We never ask for your password, codes, private keys or seed phrase — not by email, chat or phone.

riskDisclosure.title: Risk disclosure
riskDisclosure.lead: Please read this before you deposit or invest. It describes the main risks; it is not a complete list.

loss.title: You can lose money
loss.text: Investment results can be negative. A loss is posted to your position exactly like a gain. You may get back less than you invested.

noGuarantee.title: No guaranteed returns
noGuarantee.text: We do not promise any return. Past results, including those shown on product pages, do not predict future results.

volatility.title: Crypto prices are volatile
volatility.text: The value of crypto assets can change quickly and by large amounts. Values shown in US dollars are approximate and can be out of date.

liquidity.title: Your money is not always immediately available
liquidity.text: New deposits cannot be withdrawn for 7 days. Invested funds are committed for the product term; early exit, where allowed, has a fee. Withdrawals are reviewed and can take time, and may be paused if a reconciliation finds a problem.

counterparty.title: Counterparty and operational risk
counterparty.text: Strategies may use exchanges, lending venues or custodians that can fail, be hacked or freeze withdrawals. Our own systems can also fail despite the controls we use.

network.title: Blockchain risks
network.text: Funds sent on the wrong network, without a required memo or to a wrong address may be lost permanently. Blockchain transactions cannot be reversed.

regulation.title: Legal and regulatory risk
regulation.text: Rules for crypto assets differ by country and change. A product may have to be withdrawn, and you are responsible for tax on your results where you live.

protection.title: No deposit insurance
protection.text: Crypto assets held with us are not covered by bank deposit guarantee schemes or investor compensation schemes unless a product page says otherwise.

riskDisclosure.prevailing: This disclosure is provided in English, Russian, Arabic and Georgian. If the translations differ, the English version prevails.
